function.name: get_library_for_classid
function.description: This function retrieves the library for a given class ID. It first searches the activation context. If not found, it then loads the class registry key and DllPath registry value.

parameters.name: classid
parameters.description: The class ID for which the library is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer where the output will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds. If it fails, it returns an error code such as REGDB_E_READREGDB, REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG, or E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: RoGetActivationFactory
function.description: This function is used to get the activation factory for a specified class ID. It loads the library associated with the class ID, retrieves the 'DllGetActivationFactory' function from the library, and then uses this function to create the activation factory. If successful, it queries the factory for a specified interface.

parameters.name: classid
parameters.description: The class ID for which to get the activation factory.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The interface identifier to query on the activation factory.

parameters.name: class_factory
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *class_factory contains the requested interface pointer to the activation factory.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: agile_ref_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (riid) matches any of the known identifiers. If it does, it increments the reference count of the interface and returns a pointer to it. If it doesn't, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAgileReference interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier to be checked

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the pointer to the interface will be stored if the function is successful

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_INVALIDARG if any of the arguments is NULL, and E_NOINTERFACE if the provided interface identifier does not match any of the known identifiers
